title: ACDP A2A Artifact Record (0.5.0, Draft)
description: acdp-a2a-artifact/1: the record an A2A server agent carries under metadata["acdp:a2a"] of the body it signs for one completed artifact (RFC-ACDP-0022 §4). The body's type is the agent's own domain type; this record only binds the body to the A2A artifact by hashes: the three id hashes are always salted, and parts_hash is salted unless the parts are embedded. $defs/link is the value of Artifact.metadata["io.agentcontextdistributionprotocol/provenance"] (RFC-ACDP-0022 §6), the RFC-ACDP-0019 §6 value reused unchanged. $defs/inputs is the value of Message.metadata["io.agentcontextdistributionprotocol/inputs"] (§7). $defs/card_params is the params object of the Agent Card extension https://agentcontextdistributionprotocol.io/ext/a2a/v1 (§9).

a2a_protocol_version.description: The A2A protocol version the task was served under: the protocolVersion of the AgentInterface the request arrived on, e.g. 1.0.

artifact_id_hash.description: §5 over the artifactId string, always salted.

role.description: Present only under an A2A revision whose Artifact carries a role (A2A #2411). An agent signs only artifacts it authored.

task_id_hash.description: §5 over the task id string, always salted.

context_id_hash.description: §5 over the context id string, always salted.

parts_hash.description: §5 over the assembled parts array in its A2A JSON form (RFC-ACDP-0022 §5.1); salted exactly when salted is true.

salted.description: true when parts_hash is over salt ‖ JCS(parts); false when it is over JCS(parts) alone, which only an embedded record may use (RFC-ACDP-0022 §5.2). The three id hashes are salted either way.

embedded.description: true when a data_refs entry carries the parts (RFC-ACDP-0022 §5.3).

name.description: The artifact's name, truncated to 256 Unicode scalar values, when the agent records it.

description.description: The artifact's description, truncated to 1024 Unicode scalar values, when the agent records it.

link.description: Value of Artifact.metadata["io.agentcontextdistributionprotocol/provenance"]: exactly the RFC-ACDP-0019 §6 value (published link or fail-open failure).

inputs.description: Value of Message.metadata["io.agentcontextdistributionprotocol/inputs"] on a client message: the ACDP contexts the client cites as inputs, as a bare array (RFC-ACDP-0022 §7).

card_params.description: params of the Agent Card AgentExtension https://agentcontextdistributionprotocol.io/ext/a2a/v1 (RFC-ACDP-0022 §9). An untrusted pointer. A2A JSON (camelCase) names. Unknown members are ignored by clients.
